observations.why: The act of verifying calibration against reference plates performs mastery and quality-of-craft as the appealed-to good.
Labeling the instrument by name carries competence — identifying the specific tool of the craft — but the signal is thin and incidental.
Restating the verification against reference plates performs the same mastery-of-craft appeal as src-1, in summary form.
